mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate hiring and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) for 3 months indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 3 months, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 2.0% for 6 months) increases discount rates and reduces liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and rising for 6 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production level (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is above its 3-year average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1100.0 thousand units for 3 months signals housing market contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1100.0 for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market recovery phase (UNRATE falling below 4.5% for 3 months) increases consumer spending and corporate hiring, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5% for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate increase above 1.0% within 3 months signals monetary tightening that raises borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.0% in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
